note: Based on the species-level description of Trinervitermes fletcheri in Chhotani (1997), original in English; the soldier is dimorphic, with the major and minor forms combined in one paragraph; the alate is not recorded; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule yellowish brown to brown; nasus dark brown; antennae rusty yellow; abdominal tergites pale brown; sternites and legs pale yellow. Head and abdominal tergites without long setae; tip of the nasus with a few short setae; sternites with long and short setae. Total body length 4.50–5.00 mm. Head capsule, excluding the nasus, pyriform (length including nasus 2.40–2.55 mm, length excluding nasus 1.55–1.65 mm, width 1.35–1.50 mm); in profile very weakly incurved behind the base of the nasus, occiput arched, nasus swelling absent. Nasus weakly conical, slightly raised anteriorly, about half the head length excluding the nasus (length 0.80–0.90 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.49–0.55). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about 1.5 times segment 2, segment 4 almost as long as segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, without a spine. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.30 mm, width 0.60–0.75 mm); anterior lobe strongly raised, anterior margin with a deep median impression; posterior margin nearly convex. Minor soldier: head capsule yellow; legs and sternites pale yellow; abdominal tergites pale brown; pilosity as in the major soldier. Total body length 3.0–3.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, slightly incurved laterally behind the antennae (length including nasus 1.65–1.80 mm, length excluding nasus 0.98–1.05 mm, width 0.63–0.70 mm); in profile distinctly incurved behind the nasus. Nasus long, cylindrical, slightly upturned anteriorly (length 0.65–0.80 mm), about two-thirds to three-quarters of the head length (ratio of nasus length to head length 0.67–0.78). Antennae long, 12–14-segmented, usually 13-segmented; in the 12- and 13-segmented forms segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2, in the 14-segmented form segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles as in the major soldier. Pronotum small, saddle-shaped (length 0.15–0.20 mm, width 0.45–0.50 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown to reddish brown; antennae, postclypeus, labrum, pronotum and legs straw-coloured; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head and body surface with a few microscopic hairs; sternites with long and short setae. Total body length 5.0–5.9 mm. Head subsquare, wider than long (length to the base of the mandibles 1.55–1.70 mm, width 1.68–1.80 mm); coronal suture distinct. Frontal plate subtriangular, white, translucent. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 about 1.5 times segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus convex, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.45–0.50 mm, width 0.80–0.93 mm); anterior margin deeply incised, posterior margin convex.
